text: dsh-ui-skin-switcher 是面向 DSH Web 界面的模型与思考强度切换插件。它在对话输入框旁注册模型选择区域，从当前会话的模型目录读取供应商分组和可用模型，并通过会话选择接口立即切换。对于声明了推理强度选项的模型，还可用滑块选择档位，并记住本页中每个模型上次选择的强度。界面支持中英文文案、主题配色和最高档点阵动画，适合希望在撰写消息时快速切换模型与推理强度的 DSH 用户。

dsh-ui-skin-switcher adds model and reasoning controls to the DSH Web composer. It lists provider-grouped models for the current session and applies selections immediately. A slider adjusts reasoning effort for supported models and remembers each model’s last choice on the page.
想在 DSH 输入框旁直接切换当前会话使用的模型。
能不能把可用模型按服务商分组显示出来？

让不同模型分别记住我上次选的思考档位。
DSH 的模型切换和思考强度能在一个小控件里操作吗？
I want to change the model for my current DSH conversation from the composer.
Can I adjust a model’s reasoning effort without leaving the message box?
Show my available models grouped by provider and apply my choice to this session.
dsh-ui-skin-switcher 的功能「模型切换」：点击输入框旁的模型按钮可展开按服务商分组的会话模型目录，选择模型后通过当前会话的选择接口立即应用。
dsh-ui-skin-switcher 的功能「推理强度」：对提供推理强度选项的模型，打开强度菜单后可在轨道上点击或拖动滑块选择档位，并将选择应用到当前会话。
dsh-ui-skin-switcher 的功能「逐模型记忆」：切换模型时读取该模型在当前页面记录的上次推理强度；成功选择后更新记忆，便于切回时恢复对应档位。
dsh-ui-skin-switcher 的功能「中英文界面文案」：插件注册中英文界面词典，并在输入框区域渲染模型、强度、加载状态和无可用模型等提示。
dsh-ui-skin-switcher 的功能「最高档动画与主题样式」：推理强度处于最高档时显示点阵效果；滑块与菜单使用 DSH 主题变量，并在浏览器中注入样式。

section: 为什么接入模型之后没有思考强度？

@domitor-syh/dsh-ui-skin-switcher README · 常见问题：
为什么我的模型没有出现思考强度滑块？ 滑块只为提供了推理等级信息的模型显示，未支持或未配置时只显示模型切换按钮。**DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 及更高版本**可在**设置 → 模型**中配置各模型的推理等级；旧版本需自行修改配置文件。为确保模型响应正确，请参照对应厂商的模型配置文档填写支持的档位和值。
切换主题后切换器颜色不对？ 插件颜色全部绑定 DSH 主题变量（`--dsw-alias-*`），随深浅主题自动翻转。若你用了把背景设成透明的皮肤，浮层会自动启用毛玻璃（backdrop-filter）保住可读性。

@domitor-syh/dsh-ui-skin-switcher README · Introduction：A **Claude Desktop-style switcher** for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) Web GUI: change the model or dial reasoning effort without ever leaving the composer.

@domitor-syh/dsh-ui-skin-switcher README · Features：| Feature | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Model switching | Clicking the model entry expands the model list ordered by vendor; the selection applies immediately and the matching reasoning effort updates together |
| Effort slider | Supports both click and drag, with multiple effort nodes; supported levels differ per model, and adjustments apply immediately |
| Max-effort dot matrix | Reaching max effort reveals a right-to-left dot-matrix sweep on the track, with the handle glowing |
| Per-model memory | Remembers the last effort per model, kept across switches |
| Theme adaptive | All colors bound to DSH theme tokens; readable in light/dark themes and transparent skins |

Core API contracts were checked against source for `0.1.5-alpha.1`, `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.3`, `0.2.1-rc.5`, and `0.2.2-rc.1`; other builds still need confirmation, and future versions have not all been runtime-tested.

@domitor-syh/dsh-ui-skin-switcher README · Usage：1. **Pick a model** — click the button and pick from the list; the list is grouped by vendor and the current model shows a checkmark.
2. **Dial effort** — for models providing reasoning-level information, an effort button appears to the right of the model; click it, then drag the slider or tap the track to switch levels.

@domitor-syh/dsh-ui-skin-switcher README · Why is there no reasoning-effort switcher after adding a model?：The current model either does not support reasoning effort (`reasoningEfforts`) or has not been configured for it. **DSH 0.2.1-rc.1 and later** let you configure each model's reasoning levels in **Settings → Models**; earlier versions require editing the configuration file. To ensure correct model responses, use the supported levels and values from the model vendor's configuration documentation. You can also give that documentation or its link to an LLM for help configuring them.
section: Why is there no reasoning-effort switcher after adding a model?

text: @domitor-syh/dsh-ui-skin-switcher README · Why is there no reasoning-effort switcher after adding a model?：> Taking effect: you edit `settings.yaml` under the DSH home (`~/.dsh`) — **not this plugin's files**; DSH watches that file and hot-reloads, so valid changes take effect **immediately with no restart**, update the model list and effort choices, and persist across restarts.
section: Why is there no reasoning-effort switcher after adding a model?

text: @domitor-syh/dsh-ui-skin-switcher README · Why is there no reasoning-effort switcher after adding a model?：Why follow the vendor's documentation? To keep declarations accurate — **accuracy over coverage**. Supported levels and their values vary by vendor and model. Incorrect values may cause requests to fail or the configuration to have no effect, so we do not fill in a uniform preset.
